description: Two daily open data files on Italy's road fuel retail network, published by the industry ministry from information that station operators must report under article 51 of law 99/2009. Contents: the register of active stations (24,000 lines in the extraction of 28 September 2026) with station id, operator, brand, type (23,308 road, 543 motorway), name, address, municipality, province, latitude and longitude, and a price file of about 92,800 lines with fuel type (petrol, diesel, methane, LPG and others), price, self-service flag and time reported. The OpenStreetMap wiki notes coordinates are added by operators and not always verified, and that station names and addresses are inconsistent. Producer: MIMIT. Coverage: Italy, all 107 provinces named in the register. Format and access: two pipe-delimited CSV downloads updated daily with the situation at 8 am the day before; the separator changed to the pipe character on 10 February 2026; older extractions are archived. Free. Licence: Italian Open Data License IODL 2.0. Caveats: the page calls the datasets experimental; only stations that report are listed. Simulation uses: locating fuel supply nodes in road and emergency fuel supply resilience models, and price and outage analysis of the fuel network. Related records: none identified.
